## 更新内容

### 随 Cider 启动

- 新增可选的 Cider 4 插件 Lyrider Launcher：Cider 启动时自动启动 Lyrider。插件文件为本版 Release 中的 `Lyrider-Cider-Plugin_1.0.0.zip`。
- Lyrider 的 MSIX 安装包新增 `lyrider:` 协议，插件通过它启动 Lyrider。Lyrider 已在运行时不会再开第二个。
- 安装插件：把 zip 中的 `plugin.yml` 和 `plugin.js` 解压到 `%APPDATA%\sh.cider.dotnet\plugins\io.github.ayor1337.lyrider-launcher\`，重启 Cider，在 设置 > 扩展 > 插件 中启用 **Lyrider Launcher**。
- 插件需要 v1.6.1 或更新的 Lyrider。旧版没有 `lyrider:` 协议，每次启动 Cider 都会弹出“获取打开此 'lyrider' 链接的应用”。

### 随 Cider 退出

- 设置页「实验」分区新增“随 Cider 退出”开关，默认关闭。
- 开启后，Lyrider 检测到 Cider 运行过、随后退出时，会自动退出。Lyrider 比 Cider 先启动时会等待 Cider 启动，不会立即退出。
- 按 Cider 进程判断，而不是本地 API 连接状态，因此 Cider 的 API 暂时不可用时不会误退出。

## 安装与升级

下载 `Lyrider_1.6.1.0_x64.msix` 和 `Lyrider.cer`，仅支持 Windows 11 x64。首次安装前，将证书导入当前用户的“受信任人”存储，再安装 MSIX：

```powershell
Import-Certificate -FilePath .\Lyrider.cer -CertStoreLocation Cert:\CurrentUser\TrustedPeople
Add-AppxPackage .\Lyrider_1.6.1.0_x64.msix
```

已有版本使用同一证书签名时，可直接安装新 MSIX 升级。安装包包含 .NET、Windows App SDK 运行时和中英文资源。

## 验证

- Release 构建 0 警告 0 错误；逻辑及服务测试（Release）：365/365 通过，新增 Cider 退出检测测试。
- 任务栏控件测试（Release）：58/58 通过。
- 在 Cider 4.0.32 上实机测试通过：插件随 Cider 启动拉起 Lyrider，Lyrider 已运行时不重复启动，开启“随 Cider 退出”后 Lyrider 随 Cider 一起退出。

相关 Pull Request：[#35 随 Cider 启动与退出 Lyrider](https://github.com/Ayor1337/Lyrider/pull/35)。

完整变更：[v1.6.0...v1.6.1](https://github.com/Ayor1337/Lyrider/compare/v1.6.0...v1.6.1)

## Changes in English

### Start with Cider

- Added an optional Cider 4 plugin, Lyrider Launcher, that starts Lyrider when Cider starts. It ships in this Release as `Lyrider-Cider-Plugin_1.0.0.zip`.
- The Lyrider MSIX now registers the `lyrider:` protocol that the plugin opens. If Lyrider is already running, no second copy starts.
- To install the plugin, extract `plugin.yml` and `plugin.js` into `%APPDATA%\sh.cider.dotnet\plugins\io.github.ayor1337.lyrider-launcher\`, restart Cider, and enable **Lyrider Launcher** under Settings > Extensions > Plugins.
- The plugin needs Lyrider v1.6.1 or later. Older versions lack the `lyrider:` protocol, so Windows asks for an app to open the link every time Cider starts.

### Exit with Cider

- Added an experimental "Exit with Cider" option in Settings, off by default.
- When enabled, Lyrider quits once Cider has been running and then exits. If Lyrider starts before Cider, it waits for Cider instead of quitting immediately.
- Lyrider watches the Cider process rather than the local API connection, so a temporarily unavailable API does not close it.

### Installation and verification

Download `Lyrider_1.6.1.0_x64.msix` and `Lyrider.cer` for Windows 11 x64. For a first installation, import the certificate into the current user's Trusted People store using the commands above, then install the MSIX. Existing installations signed with the same certificate can upgrade directly.

The Release build had no warnings or errors. All 365 logic/service tests, including the new Cider exit detection tests, and all 58 taskbar widget tests passed. On Cider 4.0.32, a live test confirmed that the plugin starts Lyrider with Cider, that no second copy starts when Lyrider is already running, and that Lyrider exits with Cider when the option is on.

Full changelog: [v1.6.0...v1.6.1](https://github.com/Ayor1337/Lyrider/compare/v1.6.0...v1.6.1)
